تقلعفي (form IVq)
# تَقْلَعِفِّي (taqlaʕiffī) /taq.la.ʕif.fiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْلَعَفَّ (iqlaʕaffa)
# تُقْلَعَفِّي (tuqlaʕaffī) /tuq.la.ʕaf.fiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْلَعَفَّ (iqlaʕaffa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
